title: On the use of graph models to achieve individual and group fairness
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness, which is a sub-field of Responsible AI. While ethical considerations are implicit in 'fairness', the paper's main contribution and content are technical methods and metrics for achieving fairness in ML models. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a domain of study, nor does it delve into the qualitative or philosophical aspects of faith or ethical frameworks.
